title: Write your first Dockerfile
summary: The message box has no Dockerfile. Write one from scratch, build it, and run it.

tasks.title: There's a `Dockerfile` that starts from a Node image
tasks.hint: Make a new file called exactly `Dockerfile` (capital D, no extension) with the + button. The first line picks the starting image: `FROM node:24-slim`.

tasks.title: The image `my-box` builds
tasks.hint: Save the file (Ctrl + S), then in the terminal: `docker build -t my-box .` The dot means "this folder".

tasks.title: A container called `my-box`, made from that image, keeps running
tasks.hint: `docker run -d --name my-box -p 8096:8080 my-box`. If it stops, `docker logs my-box` says why. Missing packages? Copy `package.json` and run `npm install` in the Dockerfile.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:8096/web` shows the message box
tasks.hint: The app listens on 8080 inside the container: `-p 8096:8080`.
